card.name: Ends of surnames in reference lists
card.fires_on: The last piece of a split-up author surname in a citation or reference list, just before the comma and initials. It is strongest on rare, multi-part surnames.

modes.label: Surname ending in a citation
modes.description: Final piece of a long or unusual author surname right before the initials.

modes.label: Surname in a medical reference list
modes.description: Same pattern in numbered or bulleted references for health articles.

card.writes: It seems to push toward rare name-ending pieces and away from ordinary words, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the last part of an unusual author's last name in a list of references.
